import glob, pickle
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
from pathlib import Path

model = SentenceTransformer("{{embed_model}}")

def ingest(folder: str = "{{docs_dir}}", out: str = "{{index_path}}"):
    files = glob.glob(f"{folder}/**/*.txt", recursive=True)
    docs = [Path(f).read_text(errors="ignore") for f in files]
    vecs = model.encode(docs, normalize_embeddings=True, show_progress_bar=True)
    with open(out, "wb") as f:
        pickle.dump({"docs": docs, "paths": files, "vecs": vecs}, f)
    print(f"ingested {len(docs)} docs -> {out}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ingest()
